resources.string: Apps installed from the Play Store appear here, including frozen apps.

Frozen apps are thawed and Play Store opens. Telos freezes each freeze-candidate again as soon as Play installs the new version (one hour is only a fallback). Optional: while Telos Network VPN is on, those apps have no internet until you open them.
When Telos Network VPN is on, thawed Play-update apps cannot use the internet until you launch them again.
%2$d thawed app(s) will freeze again as soon as Play installs a new version (fallback %1$d hour).
